answer_1.quote: Beemo covers five use cases: open-ended generation, rewriting, summarization, and open & closed question answering (QA).
answer_1.outputs: Machine-generated texts (MGTs) and their edited versions by experts or LLMs.

answer_4.quote: Our team consists of two lead editors and 25 expert annotators, who are native English speakers and well-experienced in refining content produced by LLMs.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator receives one example at a time ... and is asked to (i) carefully read the prompt and the response; (ii) judge the response's relevance to the prompt and the category; (iii) fact check the response if required; (iv) edit the response by correcting factual inconsistency, removing hallucinations, and improving style, coherence, and fluency; and (v) proofread the edited version before submission.
